### 🌍 **Identity & Early Life**

### 🌍 **Identity & Early Life**
- **Full Name**: Francis Xavier Ngannou (publicly uses "Francis Ngannou"; middle name occasionally cited as "Zavier" in media).
- **Birth**: September 5, 1986, in Batié, a rural village in western Cameroon. (Note: Early records listed 1987; Ngannou confirmed 1986 in his memoir.)
- **Background**: Grew up in extreme poverty. Father absent; raised by mother and grandmother. Worked in illegal sand mines from age 11 to support family. Limited formal education.
- **Migration**: At 26 (2012), traveled undocumented to France seeking opportunity. Worked grueling construction jobs in Paris while homeless at times. Learned French fluently; later mastered English.
- **Citizenship**: Holds dual Cameroonian and French citizenship (naturalized French citizen circa 2019).

### 🥊 **MMA Career: Rise to Global Stardom**
#### *Pre-UFC (2013–2015)*
- Discovered MMA accidentally at Paris’s **MMA Factory** gym (owner: Fernand Lopez), initially seeking fitness. Trained while working construction.
- Turned pro in 2013. Compiled **8–1 record** on European circuit (notable win: Anthony Hamilton). Loss to Ante Delija (TKO, 2014).

#### *UFC Era (2015–2023)*
- **Debut**: Dec 19, 2015 (UFC on Fox 17) – TKO win over Luis Henrique.
- **Breakout KO**: 45-second demolition of Alistair Overeem (UFC 218, 2017) – iconic viral moment; cemented "hardest hitter" reputation.
- **Key Wins**: Curtis Blaydes (x2), Junior dos Santos, Cain Velasquez (18-second KO), Jairzinho Rozenstruik, Derrick Lewis.
- **Title Journey**:
  - *First shot*: Lost unanimous decision to Stipe Miocic (UFC 220, Jan 2018).
  - *Champion*: KO’d Miocic in Round 2 (UFC 260, March 27, 2021) to claim UFC Heavyweight Title.
  - *Lost title*: Unanimous decision to Ciryl Gane (UFC 270, Jan 22, 2022).
- **UFC Record**: 11–2 (10 finishes). **Overall MMA Record**: 17–3 (12 KOs, 4 subs, 1 dec win).  
  *Losses*: Stipe Miocic (UFC 220), Ciryl Gane (UFC 270), Ante Delija (pre-UFC).
- **Legacy Moments**: 7x Performance of the Night bonuses; fastest path to title shot in UFC HW history (3 fights).

#### *Punching Power: Verified Data*
- **2017 UFC PI Test**: Registered **129,161 franklins** (force unit) on PowerKube – equivalent to ~96 horsepower or a Ford Escort hitting a wall at 56 mph.
- **Context**: Widely reported as "hardest punch ever measured," though *not officially certified by Guinness* due to non-standardized testing. Still, universally acknowledged in combat sports science as extraordinary. Studies cite his punch force exceeding 1,000 psi.
